<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#070d1a;--bg2:#0e1729;--bd:#1c2a44;--lt:#e6ecf8;--tx:#9aa7c2;--ac:#5eead4;--acbg:rgba(94,234,212,.09);--wn:#f5b95c;--sans:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;--mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme="dark"]){--bg:#f5f7fb;--bg2:#fff;--bd:#d5ddeb;--lt:#0c1a33;--tx:#506078;--ac:#0b7a6a;--acbg:rgba(11,122,106,.08);--wn:#9a5b00}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#070d1a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:17px/1.65 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:var(--ac);text-decoration:none}a:hover{text-decoration:underline}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ac);outline-offset:3px}
h1,h2,h3,h4{color:var(--lt);margin:0;line-height:1.2}
.w{max-width:1080px;margin:auto;padding:0 28px}
header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 88%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
header .w{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:64px}
.brand{font:500 15px var(--mono);color:var(--lt)}.brand b{color:var(--ac);font-weight:500}
nav{display:flex;gap:22px;font-size:14px}nav a{color:var(--tx)}nav a:hover{color:var(--ac);text-decoration:none}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:6px;font:500 14px var(--sans);border:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--lt);cursor:pointer;background:none}
.btn.p{background:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac);color:#04121a}.btn.gh{background:#24292f;border-color:#24292f;color:#fff}.btn.gh:hover{filter:brightness(1.25);border-color:var(--ac)}.btn.li{background:#0a66c2;border-color:#0a66c2;color:#fff}.btn.li:hover{filter:brightness(1.12);border-color:#0a66c2}.btn:hover{text-decoration:none;border-color:var(--ac)}.btn.p:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
.hero{padding:150px 0 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,58px);letter-spacing:-.025em;font-weight:700}
.hero .nm{font:500 15px var(--mono);color:var(--ac);margin-bottom:16px}
.hero p{max-width:560px;margin:22px 0 0}
.term{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;font:13px/1.9 var(--mono);overflow:hidden}
.term .bar{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}.term .bar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bd)}
.term pre{margin:0;padding:18px;white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--tx);font:inherit}.term .c{color:var(--ac)}.term .k{color:var(--lt)}
.cur{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:15px;background:var(--ac);vertical-align:-2px;animation:bl 1.1s steps(1) infinite}@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:0}}
section{padding:80px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,34px);margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.sub{max-width:680px;margin:0 0 36px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 260px;gap:50px}.about p{margin:0 0 16px}
.about img{width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bd);display:block}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.chips li{font:12.5px var(--mono);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--acbg);color:var(--lt);border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transition:border-color .2s}.card:hover{border-color:var(--ac)}
.card h3{font-size:19px}.card h4{font-size:16px}.card p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;flex:1}
.badge{align-self:flex-start;font:12px var(--mono);color:var(--ac);border:1px solid var(--ac);border-radius:20px;padding:2px 11px}.badge.i{color:var(--wn);border-color:var(--wn)}
.tl{position:relative;margin-left:8px;padding-left:34px;border-left:2px solid var(--bd)}
.job{position:relative;margin-bottom:38px}.job:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-43px;top:7px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--bg)}
.job .when{font:13px var(--mono);color:var(--ac)}.job h3{font-size:21px;margin:4px 0 2px}.job .org{margin-bottom:12px}
.job ul,.pl{padding-left:20px;margin:0}.job li{margin-bottom:6px}
.vid{position:relative;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:#000;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.vid video{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover}
.play{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(4,10,22,.35);border:0;cursor:pointer}
.play span{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);display:grid;place-items:center}
.play span:after{content:"";border-left:20px solid #04121a;border-top:12px solid transparent;border-bottom:12px solid transparent;margin-left:6px}
.play[hidden]{display:none}figcaption{font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--tx);margin-top:8px}figure{margin:0}
.big{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:30px}.big .in{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.note{border-left:3px solid var(--wn);padding:10px 16px;background:var(--acbg);font-size:14.5px;margin-top:26px;max-width:760px}
.ct{text-align:center;max-width:620px;margin:auto}.ct .row{justify-content:center}
footer{padding:30px;text-align:center;font:12px var(--mono);border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
@media(max-width:820px){nav{display:none}.hero,.about,.big{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:110px}.about img{max-width:220px}section{padding:60px 0}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.cur{animation:none}.card{transition:none}}

body{background:radial-gradient(900px 520px at 85% -5%,rgba(94,234,212,.11),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at -10% 35%,rgba(56,130,246,.09),transparent 60%),var(--bg);background-attachment:fixed}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--bd) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bd) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;opacity:.22;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,#000,transparent 70%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,#000,transparent 70%)}
.gr{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5eead4,#60a5fa);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.btn{transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,filter .2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn.p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5eead4,#38bdf8);border-color:transparent}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 36px;margin-top:38px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
.stats b{display:block;font:600 28px/1.1 var(--sans);color:var(--lt)}.stats span{font-size:13px}
.main .w,main .w{counter-reset:sec}
section h2:before{counter-increment:sec;content:"0" counter(sec) " /";display:block;font:500 13px var(--mono);color:var(--ac);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.card{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03) inset,0 14px 30px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -22px rgba(94,234,212,.3)}
#skills .card{border-top:2px solid var(--ac)}
.about img{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--acbg),0 24px 50px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.job{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;padding:22px 26px}.job:before{top:27px}
.chips li{transition:border-color .2s,color .2s}.chips li:hover{border-color:var(--ac)}
.term{box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
header{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02)}nav a{position:relative}nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-6px;height:1px;background:var(--ac);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .2s}nav a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}
footer a{color:var(--tx)}footer a:hover{color:var(--ac)}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .6s,transform .6s}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.stats{gap:12px 26px}.job{padding:18px}}

<section id="about"><div class="about"><div><h2>About me</h2>
<p>I started with Information Security and Digital Forensics, where I learned how digital evidence is collected and how security incidents happen. I then expanded into network security, FortiGate firewall implementation, virtualized network infrastructure, vulnerability assessment and security monitoring.</p>
<p>I am passionate about identifying security weaknesses, monitoring suspicious activity, analysing network traffic and understanding how incidents occur.</p>
<p>Areas I focus on:</p><ul class="chips"><li>SOC</li><li>Threat detection & analysis</li><li>Security monitoring</li><li>Incident response</li><li>Network security</li><li>Firewall management</li><li>VAPT</li><li>Digital forensics</li><li>Packet analysis</li></ul></div>
<img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Ranjini U" width="260" height="270"></div></section>

<section id="skills"><h2>Technical skills</h2><p class="sub">Grouped by area. These reflect my coursework, projects and internships.</p><div class="g">
<div class="card"><h4>Network security</h4><ul class="chips"><li>FortiGate firewall</li><li>Firewall policies</li><li>NAT</li><li>VPN</li><li>VLAN</li><li>TCP/IP</li><li>Subnetting</li><li>IDPS</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><h4>SOC & threat detection</h4><ul class="chips"><li>Security monitoring</li><li>Threat detection fundamentals</li><li>Incident response fundamentals</li><li>Log & packet analysis</li><li>Network traffic analysis</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><h4>Virtualization & infrastructure</h4><ul class="chips"><li>OpenStack</li><li>Open Source MANO (OSM)</li><li>NFV</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><h4>Security tools</h4><ul class="chips"><li>Wireshark</li><li>Nmap</li><li>Burp Suite</li><li>Metasploit</li><li>Kali Linux</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><h4>Digital forensics</h4><ul class="chips"><li>EnCase</li><li>FTK</li><li>Autopsy</li><li>Digital evidence analysis</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><h4>Programming & development</h4><ul class="chips"><li>Python</li><li>Tkinter</li><li>MongoDB</li><li>Basic web development</li></ul></div></div></section>

<section id="experience"><h2>Experience</h2><p class="sub">Internship timeline.</p><div class="tl">
<div class="job"><span class="when">12 March 2025 – 11 August 2025</span><h3>Cybersecurity Analyst Intern</h3><p class="org">Cappricio Securities · Chennai</p><ul><li>Worked alongside the Cybersecurity Analyst team.</li><li>Gained exposure to security analysis, threat detection and security monitoring.</li><li>Learned incident response procedures and everyday cybersecurity practices.</li><li>Identified security vulnerabilities and prepared technical content.</li><li>Designed and executed network test cases using OpenStack and Open Source MANO (OSM) to validate virtualized network functions, service chaining and network performance (tools: OpenStack, OSM, NFV, packet analysis).</li><li>Received a Letter of Completion signed by the Founder and CEO.</li></ul></div>
</div></section>

<section id="projects"><h2>Featured projects</h2><p class="sub">Academic and learning projects.</p><div class="g">
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Project</span><h3>FortiGate Firewall Implementation</h3><p>Configured and worked with FortiGate firewall policies, NAT configurations, intrusion prevention settings and network traffic segmentation.</p><ul class="chips"><li>FortiGate</li><li>NAT</li><li>IPS</li><li>VLANs</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Project</span><h3>Intrusion Detection & Prevention System</h3><p>Network monitoring and packet analysis to identify suspicious traffic patterns, understand signature-based detection and prevent unauthorized network activity.</p><ul class="chips"><li>IDPS</li><li>Wireshark</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Project</span><h3>RedirectHunter: Open Redirect Vulnerability Scanner</h3><p>A Node.js-based cybersecurity tool focused on identifying potential Open Redirect vulnerabilities through URL parameter testing, HTTP response analysis and structured vulnerability reporting.</p><ul class="chips"><li>JavaScript</li><li>Node.js</li><li>HTTP Response Analysis</li><li>JSON Reporting</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Project</span><h3>Poseidon: Phishing Awareness &amp; Social Engineering Audit</h3><p>A cloud-based social engineering security auditing tool that demonstrates phishing attack techniques through simulated login pages, helping understand credential security, phishing risks and user awareness.</p><ul class="chips"><li>Node.js</li><li>JavaScript</li><li>Express.js</li><li>EJS</li><li>HTML/CSS</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Project</span><h3>Color Detection Using OpenCV</h3><p>A computer vision project that uses OpenCV and Python to detect and identify colors in images or video frames based on pixel values, helping understand image processing and real-time color recognition.</p><ul class="chips"><li>Python</li><li>OpenCV</li><li>NumPy</li><li>Computer Vision</li></ul></div></div></section>

<section id="soc"><h2>Beyond Security Testing: My Interest in SOC Operations</h2>
<p class="sub">I am particularly interested in how Security Operations Centres monitor infrastructure, identify suspicious activities, investigate security alerts and respond to cyber threats.</p>
<div class="g"><div class="card"><span class="badge i">Learning interests</span><ul class="chips"><li>SIEM & security log analysis</li><li>Threat intelligence</li><li>Network traffic monitoring</li><li>Security event correlation</li><li>Incident investigation</li><li>Alert triage</li><li>Threat detection & response</li></ul></div>
<div class="card"><span class="badge">Hands-on so far</span><p>Security monitoring exposure and threat detection at Cappricio Securities, plus packet analysis, traffic analysis and IDPS work in my projects and internships.</p></div></div>
<p class="note">The learning interests above are areas I am studying. They are not professional experience.</p></section>

<section id="ideas"><h2>Project ideas</h2><p class="sub">Planned and proposed work, not completed projects.</p><div class="g">

<section id="education"><h2>Education & certifications</h2><div class="g">
<div class="card"><h4>MCA</h4><p>S-VYASA Deemed to be University, Bengaluru<br>2025 – present</p></div>

<script>
const RESUME_B64="";
document.querySelectorAll('a[download]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
e.preventDefault();
try{const bin=atob(RESUME_B64),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);

const l=document.createElement('a');l.href=url;l.download='Ranjini_U_Resume.pdf';document.body.appendChild(l);l.click();l.remove();
setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500)}catch(err){window.open('Ranjini_U_Resume.pdf','_blank')}}));

b.addEventListener('click',()=>{b.hidden=true;v.play().catch(()=>{b.hidden=false})});
